persona: Implementation analyst at a payroll SaaS company aiming for a consultant role
resumeText:
Sneha Kulkarni | Pune | sneha.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Implementation Analyst, PayNest Software, Pune (2022 - present)
- Configured the payroll product for 18 mid-size customers, setting up workflows, approval rules and user roles.
- Ran discovery calls with HR teams and wrote requirement documents for each rollout.
- Wrote SQL queries to validate migrated employee records before go-live.
- Cleaned and mapped legacy employee data from Excel files into the product import templates.
- Prepared UAT scripts and supported customer users through acceptance testing and sign-off.
- Logged product bugs in Jira and followed them up with the engineering team.

Customer Support Associate, PayNest Software, Pune (2021 - 2022)
- Answered customer tickets about payslips and tax settings.

SKILLS
REST APIs, Postman, SQL, Excel, Jira

EDUCATION
BCom, Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2021
